# `internal/provider/testdata`

Reference fixtures for `TestAccImportFidelity`, the end-to-end adoption test
(Task 13 / spec section 10). The test imports `leaf.crt` — a certificate
produced by `openssl` the way `reconcile/engine.py` produces one — and asserts
the subsequent plan is empty. That assertion only passes if `ImportState`
reconstructed every input attribute byte-exactly from the certificate's DER,
which is the property the homelab migration depends on.

## These are not secrets

Every key here was generated fresh for the test suite. Nothing was copied from
the cluster, from Bitwarden, or from any other deployment. These keys sign
nothing outside the import-fidelity test, no device trusts them, and they are
regenerable from the commands in [`../../../internal/pki/testdata/README.md`](../../../internal/pki/testdata/README.md).

**Nothing from the cluster or from Bitwarden may ever be placed in this
directory.** These fixtures are throwaway keys whose only purpose is to give the
adoption test a certificate produced by `engine.py`'s toolchain.

## Why a copy, not a symlink

These four files are byte-identical copies of the fixtures in
`internal/pki/testdata/`, which were generated by Plan 1 Task 15. Symlinking
across package boundaries is fragile in Go tests — the test working directory
the `terraform-plugin-testing` harness creates is not the package directory, so
a relative symlink can resolve to the wrong path under `go test`'s chdir rules.
Copying costs nothing (the keys are regenerable and the suite is the only
consumer) and removes a class of cross-package path bugs.

See [`../../../internal/pki/testdata/README.md`](../../../internal/pki/testdata/README.md)
for the full regeneration commands and for what each file is.

## Files

| File       | What it is                                                          |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ca.key`   | Throwaway ECDSA P-256 CA key, SEC1 PEM (`EC PRIVATE KEY`).          |
| `ca.crt`   | Self-signed CA certificate, `CN=homelab-golden-ca`, `keyCertSign,cRLSign`. |
| `leaf.key` | Throwaway RSA-2048 subject key, PKCS#8 PEM (`PRIVATE KEY`).         |
| `leaf.crt` | The reference leaf certificate, serial `0x2001`, issued by `ca.crt`. |
